purpose: Synthetic cases for the presentation stage C.3 (refinements 03, change 7): the approved determination and its identifiers must survive translation and formatting. stored_results and learnings are the material C.3 receives; reference_answer, invalid_presentation and review_checks belong only to a later semantic evaluation of a real model: they are never sent to the model nor read by production code. Scripted tests prove the material and the protocol, not the fidelity of a real generation. No benchmark question or answer key.

cases.name: marker_letter_matches_approved_item
cases.user_question: Qual das amostras tem a maior densidade? A) alumínio B) cobre C) chumbo D) ferro. Termine com a linha FINAL_ANSWER: LETRA.
general_criteria: AC2: End with the line FINAL_ANSWER: LETTER.
cases.stored_results:
## T1 — Comparação das densidades

Com as massas e os volumes medidos, a amostra de cobre tem a maior densidade entre as amostras de alumínio, cobre e ferro analisadas na tabela; a de chumbo não foi medida e não pode ser comparada.

**Conclusion:** A amostra de maior densidade entre as medidas é a de cobre, que corresponde à opção B.

learnings.content: Alternativas: A) alumínio; B) cobre; C) chumbo; D) ferro.
A amostra de cobre tem a maior densidade entre as amostras medidas (alumínio, cobre e ferro).

cases.reference_answer:
A amostra de maior densidade entre as medidas é a de cobre.

FINAL_ANSWER: B
cases.invalid_presentation:
A amostra de maior densidade é a de cobre.

FINAL_ANSWER: C
review_checks: The marker line carries the letter that labels copper (B), the item the results determined.
The text and the marker designate the same item.

cases.name: translation_keeps_branches_direction_and_condition
cases.user_question: Resuma em português o que aconteceu com os estoques das filiais em maio.
general_criteria: AC2: Report the change of each branch's stock in May.
cases.stored_results:
## T1 — Stock changes in May

Excluding customer returns, as stated in the inventory rules, the east branch's stock decreased by 12 units in May and the west branch's stock increased by 5 units.

**Conclusion:** In May, excluding returns, the east branch lost 12 units of stock and the west branch gained 5.

learnings.content: Regra de inventário: devoluções de clientes não entram na contagem.

cases.reference_answer: Em maio, desconsiderando as devoluções de clientes, o estoque da filial leste diminuiu 12 unidades e o da filial oeste aumentou 5 unidades.
cases.invalid_presentation: Em maio, o estoque da filial leste aumentou 12 unidades e o da oeste diminuiu 5.
review_checks: East decreases and west increases, as in the results; the branches are not swapped.
The month, the quantities and the exclusion of returns are kept.

cases.name: code_paired_literally_with_approved_object
cases.user_question: Os itens testados foram SB-12 (suporte de aço) e AL-07 (suporte de alumínio). Informe o código do item reprovado no ensaio de carga.
general_criteria: AC2: Give the code of the item that failed.
cases.stored_results:
## T1 — Load test outcome

The aluminium bracket deformed permanently under the test load, while the steel bracket stayed within the elastic limit.

**Conclusion:** The aluminium bracket is the item that failed the load test.

learnings.content: Itens: SB-12 — suporte de aço; AL-07 — suporte de alumínio.

cases.reference_answer: O item reprovado no ensaio de carga é o AL-07 (suporte de alumínio).
cases.invalid_presentation: O item reprovado no ensaio de carga é o SB-12 (suporte de alumínio).
review_checks: The code is the one the question's notes attach to the aluminium bracket.
No code is taken from the position of the item in the list.

cases.name: approved_best_fit_presented_as_best_fit
cases.user_question: Qual é aproximadamente o volume de água no tanque? A) 20 L B) 25 L C) 30 L D) 40 L
cases.stored_results:
## T1 — Water volume

With the measured dimensions, the volume is about 31 L. Comparing with the options, 30 L (C) is the closest and the measurement precision does not distinguish 31 L from 30 L; the other options differ by 6 L or more.

**Conclusion:** The estimated volume is about 31 L; option C) 30 L is the best fit.

learnings.content: Alternativas: A) 20 L; B) 25 L; C) 30 L; D) 40 L.

cases.reference_answer: C) 30 L — a melhor aproximação para o volume estimado de cerca de 31 L.
review_checks: Presents the choice as the best fit for the estimate, without a false equality.
Does not refuse the approved choice for lack of exactness.
